messages.subject: Normality for residual distributions
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I have questions about normality for residual distributions. First, is that the models still use the assumptions of normality for residual distributions? If so, How can I visualize some of the linear models of the OTUs and their residuals/q-q plots? And what can I do if some of the OTUs abundances is drastically violating the assumptions of normality?

I hope for hearing from you soon. Thanks a lot.
HM Z

messages.subject: Re: NA/NaN argument error
messages.body_plain:
Hi Alina,

I would first go through the discussion above and try following each of Himel's troubleshooting suggestions. It seems this has worked for some people. I couldn't get it to run without the warnings but found that the results from the example data set (included in the package - use "example()") produced the exact same results as those posted in the online tutorial and that the warnings are possibly due to some data formatting issue. Maybe try that if troubleshooting fails.

Thanks,
Kyu
